topic: Cold or flu? How to tell the difference

hook.text: Cold or flu? Here are three ways to tell.

beats.text: One: speed. Flu comes on quickly, often within a few hours. A cold creeps in gradually.
Two: where you feel it. A cold mainly affects your nose and throat. Flu hits more than that, with body aches, a high temperature and exhaustion.
Three: how you cope. With a cold, you can usually carry on as normal. Flu can leave you too exhausted to carry on.
Either way, rest and drink plenty of water, and stay home if you have a high temperature.
If flu symptoms do not improve after seven days, or you feel short of breath, talk to a doctor.
